parsed.name: FireSting光学氧测量仪
parsed.description: PyroScience FireSting 系列光学氧测量仪，用于连接光纤或探针式氧传感器，执行氧测量、零点/空气校准、背景校正，并读取温度、压力、湿度及测量结果寄存器，适用于溶解氧或气相氧实验监测。
parsed.description_en: A PyroScience FireSting series optical oxygen meter for fiber-optic or probe-based oxygen sensors. It performs oxygen measurements, zero/air calibration, background correction, and reads temperature, pressure, humidity, and result registers for dissolved-oxygen or gas-phase oxygen experiments.
